Concept & pitch deck · BN Hotel, Blida · 2026

BN Signature A hotel’s evenings, made bookable.

A concept for BN Hotel in Blida: its rooms, its restaurant and its private tables, turned into experiences guests can ask for. And the animated deck, in French, that pitches it to the hotel.

BN Signature

What it does

The idea Each service becomes an experience. “Une nuit à retenir”, “L’Escapade gourmande”, “La Table privée”: the hotel’s evenings, named and brought together.
The request From a wish to a request, in four steps. The guest composes a request for a celebration. Nothing is confirmed without the hotel’s team.
The deck A pitch that moves like a film. Fifteen slides that develop one after another, made to be presented to the hotel’s management in a meeting.
The plan Validate, show, build, launch. A launch in four stages, and the measures that say whether it works.

Try it yourself

  1. Open the deck and move with the arrow keys, or tap on a phone.
  2. Go to slide 10 and compose a celebration request yourself: nothing is sent.
  3. Use the deck’s exit to come back to the portfolio.

Open the live demo

My part

I wrote the concept, then designed and built the deck: a web page with its own animation, made to be presented full screen.
